notes.title: Euro Fishing: Lilies Out Now!
notes.content:
Dovetail Games is thrilled to announce Lilies, the next add-on in the studio’s dedicated post-release support for Euro Fishing.

Lilies is a 10-acre venue that is as beautiful as its residents and is named after the abundance of lilies on the surface of the lake. This venue is known for its big fish and provides a challenge with lots of weeds present and the stock of fish being low. However, with every fish being of specimen size with Carp up to 50 lbs and Catfish to 100lbs the rewards are definitely there.

Players can find 11 different species of fish below the lily-covered waters, along with a further 20 new boss fish and 10 additional trophies ensuring this new add-on is another huge helping of content for Euro Fishing fans to enjoy.

“We’re delighted to offer this next piece of additional content for Euro Fishing players, adding even further dedicated post-launch support for our growing fanbase” said Des O’Connor, Producer for Euro Fishing at Dovetail Games. “Lilies is a special release for Euro Fishing, providing challenge and reward in equal measure against a stunning backdrop that we’re certain new and old players alike will love!”

notes.title: Euro Fishing: Hunters Lake Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7121097/170460a84342bdae80b7def625bea83001df9f57.png[/img]

We’ve had urban fishing. We’ve had scenic lakes. We’ve even had a grand Welsh castle. Now Euro Fishing fans can look forward to all out action, as Hunter’s Lake DLC adds a heavily-stocked lake to the huge range of fishing venues available in the game.

Your main challenge will be the huge Roach roaming in Hunter’s Lake waters. With five islands dotted around this 8-acre lake, you have plenty of different options to tackle the Roach. Those who find the right approach will be rewarded with specimens that weigh up to the 4lbs, a tantalising prize for all anglers.

It’s not just Roach you’ll be up against. There are 10 different species of fish at Hunter’s Lake, including Tench, Bream, Perch, Rudd and Carp that weigh up to 32lbs. Skilled anglers will also battle 20 new boss fish, with 10 new trophies to unlock.

“We’re upping the ante for Hunter’s Lake,” said Des O’Connor, Producer at Dovetail Games, “This action-packed lake will keep fishing fans of all skill levels on their toes and the fast pace keeps the gameplay fresh and exciting for Euro Fishing owners.”

notes.title: Euro Fishing: Bergsee Out Now!
notes.content:
Euro Fishing's newest venue, Bergsee, is now available and with it a brand new species of fish - Perch.

It isn’t just the challenge of catching Perch that awaits anglers at Bergsee. The picturesque 15-acre lake, nestled in the foothills of the Austrian mountains, is also home to some of the largest coarse fish seen in Euro Fishing to date. Some of the lake monsters that can be found at Bergsee include Carp that have grown to 36lbs, Bream over 19lbs and Tench over 14lbs.

“We’re incredibly excited to bring Perch to Euro Fishing,” said Desmond O’Connor, Fishing Producer at Dovetail Games, “For those fans who think they’ve mastered everything Euro Fishing has to offer, we can’t wait to see how well they fare against this new challenge!”

Bergsee is the fourth and final DLC release in Euro Fishing’s season pass and will be free to season pass owners or you can buy it individually for £8.99/€10.99/$10.99.

notes.title: Euro Fishing February Update Out Now!
notes.content:
We’re delighted to announce that our latest update for Euro Fishing is out now! 

With this update you will see the addition of the reel speed which will allow you to increase and decrease the speed at which you reel in. You can do this with [/] or RB/LB on a controller. 

Also with this patch we are happy to tell you that there are 5 new RidgeMonkey lines! The lines included are as follows:
-	RidgeMonkey RM-Tec Mono 12lb (Green)
-	RidgeMonkey RM-Tec Mono 15lb (Brown)
-	RidgeMonkey RM-Tec Mono 18lb (Clear)
-	RidgeMonkey RM-Tec Fluoro 20lb (Clear/white)
-	RidgeMonkey RM-Tec Braid 30lb (Green)

That’s not all on the new equipment front. We have also added 12 new baits to the game!
-	Baitworks Monster Red 18mm Boilie
-	Baitworks Scent from Heaven 15mm Pop Up
-	Baitworks Scent from Hell 15mm Pop Up
-	Hydra Baits SOS 20mm Boilie
-	Hydra Baits Hex 14mm Pop Up
-	Mainline Banoffee 15mm Boilie
-	Mainline Tutti Fruitti 15mm Pop Up
-	Mainline Milky Toffee 15mm Pop Up
-	Mainline Tuna Match Boilies 8mm Boilie
-	Enterprise Tackle Niteglow boilies small 
-	Enterprise Tackle Niteglow Sweetcorn small
-	Enterprise Tackle Imitation Prawns Large

In other changes we have moved the button for changing swims in Single Player Tournaments to 'X' if you are using a controller. The behaviour of Leather Carp has been adjusted to make it more realistic and a wider range of the species will now take the appropriate baits.

Full patch notes can be found below
[list]
[*] Reel Speed – reel speed can now be increased/decreased using [/].
[*] ‘Change swim’ in single player tournaments is now set to ‘X’.
[*] 'Reset cast’ control is now set to ‘B’ to make room for reel speed controls
[*] 5 new lines and 12 new baits have been added to the Tackle Shop.
[*] Adjusted Leather Carp behaviour to be more realistic, a wider weight range of the species now take the appropriate baits.
[*] Audio improvements for ambience and footsteps.
[*] Fixed audio issue with slipping line.
[*] Fixed crash when removing Ethernet cable. (Xbox only)
[*] Various minor localisation bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Waldsee Out Now!
notes.content:
We're delighted to announce our new venue, "Waldsee", is out now!

Waldsee, which means 'forest lake' in German, lives up to its name as it transports Euro Fishing players to a hidden hideaway surrounded by dense woodland and sun-kissed rocks. In fact, Waldsee is such a well-kept secret that even its exact stock of fish remains a mystery. You'll get to explore these uncharted waters for yourself, with all sorts of surprises awaiting skilled anglers. The exact stock is unknown but early visitors have caught carp up to 62lbs and catfish up to 68lbs.

"Waldsee will offer a brand-new experience for Euro Fishing fans with its stunning fish and scenic views while also remaining a secret to the fishing community at large. It's the type of fishing spot that's harder and harder to find nowadays and we wanted to somewhere that takes you away from the real world, giving you an intimate and personal environment where you can fish at your own pace."

Waldsee is the the third venue in the Euro Fishing Season pass and will be free to season pass owners or you can buy it individually for £8.99/€10.99/$10.99.

Waldsee has over 600 fish stocked in its lake and 20 new boss fish to catch, with 10 new trophies/achievements on offer for skilled fishermen.

notes.title: Euro Fishing Update Out Now!
notes.content:
We are happy to tell you that our latest patch for Euro Fishing is out now.

With this update you will notice improvements to the first tutorial, ‘The Basics’, which now gives users the choice of using Total or Basic Cast Control and now features a fish fight. While making this changes we have also improved the flow of the tutorial with changes to timings and other minor bug fixes.

We have also made improvements to the water to make it look more realistic when the wind is set to static. Additionally there have been updates to the audio for reeling in and netting a fish as well as the ambient audio. In Live Tournaments we have fixed an issue where the leaderboard fail to load.

In the menus you can now view Koi and Ghost Carp to the species section of the Angler’s Log. We have also fixed the Korda IQ-D 4 rig not appearing in the tackle shop.

Full patch notes can be found here:
[list]
[*] ‘The Basics’ tutorial has been updated to give players the choice of Total or Basic Cast Control and now features a fish fight. General flow of the tutorial has been improved by adjusting timers and various minor bug fixes.
[*] Koi and Ghost Carp can now been viewed in the Angler’s Log in the ‘Species’ section.
[*] Water has been improved to now look more realistic when setting the wind to ‘Static’.
[*] Ambience audio has been slightly adjusted and improved.
[*] Fixed issue regarding the audio for reeling in and landing a fish into the net from the lake.
[*] Fixed issue where ‘Korda IQ-D 4’ rig wasn’t appearing in the tackle shop.
[*] Fixed issue where the leaderboard would fail to load in Live Tournaments.
[*] Various minor bug fixes
[/list]
We are also delighted to say that our next venue 'Waldsee' will be released on Tuesday 9th January 2018!

notes.title: Le Lac d'or Out now!
notes.content:
We’re delighted to announce the release of our newest venue, Le Lac d’Or, on all platforms!

Le Lac d’or (The Golden Lake) is a 25 acre venue surrounded by woodland and nestled in the French countryside. This mature lake is an ideal holiday venue with three log cabins each with their own pegs accommodating up to 4 anglers for you to fish from.

The size of the fish that reside here is the most impressive feature with some huge specimens lurking beneath the surface waiting to be caught. The lake introduces Koi Carp to Euro Fishing for the first time as well as specimen sized Carp, Catfish, Tench, Bream and Roach.

Current lake records stand at 71lb 8oz for Carp, 15lb 2oz for Bream, 11lb 3oz for Tench and 4lb 1oz for Roach. Most impressive are the catfish with several breaking the 100lb barrier with the biggest currently being 126lbs 3oz.

notes.title: Euro Fishing Update Out Now!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the release of our newest update to Euro Fishing. 

With this patch we are excited to be able to tell you we have moved the “Catch Shot” camera so the images of you holding your prize catch should now be full frame and away from your rods.  We have added 9 new rigs in your tackle shop, the Krank (for gravel), Dark Matter (for silt) & and the Hinge Stiff (for weed) rigs from Korda. They are available in sizes 4, 6 and 8 and can be found in the Carp section of the Tackle Shop. In addition to this we have a new t-shirt available in the character creation from Cygnet Tackle. You will also notice new UI elements with the Main Menu bar being reworked and a DLC store tab being added to the game.

We have also made improvements to the water of the core lakes and have addressed the most commonly reported issue of the bait drifting so this should occur much less frequently now.

Full patch notes below.
[list]
[*] 9 new rigs have been added to the Tackle Shop.
[*] 1 new t-shirt has been added for character creation.
[*] Catch shots have been updated to allow for larger fish to be fully in frame -
 and rods not to be in picture.
[*] Bait drifting has been improved so should happen less frequently.
[*] Main menu bar has been updated with new menu icons.
[*] Dovetail Store has been implemented in game to purchase DLC.
[*] Water quality on the core game lakes has been updated.
[*] Improvements have been made to how fish behave when fighting on the line.
[*] Various minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Manor Farm Lake Update Information
notes.content:
Hi all,

We are aware that our latest patch (released on Monday) has introduced a rare bug that can overwrite player profiles. We think that this is only affecting a small percentage of Steam profiles and are working on a fix for this as a matter of absolute urgency. We will bring you more information as soon as possible.

If you have been affected by this bug, we are very sorry if your progress has been altered and will investigate appropriate options with you – get straight in touch here: https://dovetailgames.kayako.com.

UPDATE: We now have a hotfix in testing for the profile overwrite bug that several of you have reported.

We have also identified a way to avoid this bug in the meantime. If you catch a fish in Freedom Fishing, please edit your tackle box before you exit the session. To do this, go to any of the teleport boards around each lake and make a small change to one of your tackle boxes (e.g. change a rod, bait, rig.) Click yes to save the changes. Once you have done this you can exit to the main menu and exit the game.

As soon as the hotfix for this issue clears testing and is moved to release we will let you all know. Once again, if you have experienced this bug, please contact us at https://dovetailgames.kayako.com

Following on from the cool counter-culture urban fishing of Euro Fishing’s Foundry Dock DLC, Dovetail Games will kick off its Season Pass with Manor Farm Lake. As the most famous day-ticket complex in the country, it’s a venue that every angling enthusiast knows well, and this officially licensed DLC release for Euro Fishing captures every last detail of the enormous 14-acre lake.

Manor Farm Lake is the first of four fishing venues released for Euro Fishing’s Season Pass.

We’re not sure what the record is for the amount of fish in a video game is but our Season Pass shows that we’re serious about breaking it!”

Known for its big fish, Manor Farm Lake is home to over 700 carp, but that’s not all skilled anglers can catch. Manor Farm Lake also has roach, bream, tench, and catfish lurking beneath its surface, while there are 23 new boss fish to catch as well. The DLC also offers 10 new achievements for those who want to prove their angling skills to the world.

notes.title: Euro Fishing Patch Out Now!
notes.content:
Dear All,
We are pleased to say that our next patch is now available for PC. This significant update see’s many improvements and fixes to the core game. We have improved the fish AI meaning that the fish fight all the way to the bank and you will know very quickly whether you are into a monster or not by the amount of tension the fish is putting onto the line. We have also fully connected the line to the reel which now spins with the bail arm.
The full list of notes are as follows;
• Games engine has been upgraded to 4.15.
• Line on the rod is now fully connected to the reel.
• Improved fish AI to make fights feel more realistic.
• Line tension has been modified, clutch is now set to 40 by default.
• Improved visual movement of reel moving
• Multiplayer Matchmaking UI has been updated.
• Implementation of content add on system.
• New lake add on available.
• Fixed issue where incorrect boss fish thumbnails would be displayed in the Angler’s Log.
• Fixed an issue where opening rod select widget whilst reeling would cancel in reeling.
• Improved times on loading screens.
• Fixed issues that would sometimes prevent Academy tutorials from being completed.
• Fixed multiple collision boxes on environmental assets.
• Fixed issue regarding physics of the line when reeling in.
• Fixed bug where after picking up a rod with a fish on, the fish will instantly be lost.
• High line tension with the clutch set to 0 should now occur less frequently.
• Various text clipping issues have been fixed.
• Fixed issue where incorrect button prompts would appear.
• Fixed inconsistencies in some tackle shop item names.
• Fixed bug where brands/logos would appear upside down on rods.
• Fixed bug regarding cast lines when teleporting, whilst holding a cast out rod.
• Fixed bug where lines could get stuck in specific trees that hindered gameplay during Academy levels and Challenges.
• Implementation of Dovetail Live service.

notes.title: Community Update
notes.content:
As you’re all aware, we’ve been very quiet recently about what we’ve got planned for Euro Fishing, but now we’ve got enough solid progress to be able to get you all updated on our plans for the next few weeks.

[h1] Euro Fishing Patch: [/h1]

We had originally hoped to release a patch that brought all platforms in line with one another, as we launched on PlayStation 4. In the process of developing that update for XBOX and PC we encountered a couple of critical issues that resulted in it being held back for more work. We then saw the severity of the “fish on land bug” and set about adding that fix to the overall update, so the whole patch has taken a little longer than we planned.

We know we’ve been incredibly quiet. It was important that as we got on with the update, we didn’t give you any incorrect information if we could avoid it. We do appreciate all the constructive feedback received and you’ve done some amazing bug reporting and idea giving.

So – that’s where we are at with a patch. Our small Fishing development team have been working hard on a development update for all three platforms, PC/XBOX/PS4. This update will address some of the bugs and issues you’ve carefully reported. We hope to be bringing you patch notes and a date of release for each platform as soon as we can, it’s currently close to done and going through rounds of testing.
 
[h1]Foundry Dock Add-On: [/h1]

For those of you asking how the Foundry Dock Add-On is progressing, well, it’s very close to completion! We will be able to bring you a release date soon once it passes its first round of certification with the XBOX and PS4 platforms.

Thanks for all of your detailed feedback and your continued support of Euro Fishing, you guys are awesome!

notes.title: New Live Tournaments launch tomorrow
notes.content:
The December league gets under way tomorrow and we are excited to say that the daily tournaments have had a revamp! The tournaments are now designed to add variety on a day to day basis but also stay true to the fish that you want to catch from each lake and the kind of competitions you could expect to fish in real life, testing all of your angling techniques and skills over the course of the week. The new schedule is as follows;

Event name: Linear Monday – St Johns Lake

Event date and time: Every Monday from 8am GMT for 24 hours

‘Linear Monday’ takes place on the famous St Johns Lake and is a great way to start the competitive week. Being a big open gravel pit, there is plenty of opportunities to cast at long range but the margins should never be ignored! The challenge is to catch the biggest combined weight of common carp and catfish that you can with 2 x 60 minute attempts to record your best score.

Event name: 3-Coarse Tuesday – The Observatory

Event date and time: Every Tuesday from 8am GMT for 24 hours

‘3-Coarse Tuesday’ is the tournament that shows it’s not all about catching those huge carp! Here you are targeting the bream, tench and roach but remember that despite The Observatory being our introductory lake, it still contains some specimen sized fish! The action should be fast paced and to reflect that you have to catch as many fish as possible with 4 x 30 minute attempts available to record your best score.

Event name: Carp Wednesday – Digger Lake

Event date and time: Every Wednesday from 8am GMT for 24 hours

‘Carp Wednesday’ takes place on Digger Lakes – our licensed venue based in Devon, UK. This intimate lake is a series of islands and channels, perfect for stalking the carp that reside in here. You may have to stay mobile as they use the layout of the lake to their advantage, always looking to seek shelter. Being a carp only venue, only carp count and you need to catch the biggest combined weight of fish that you can with 2 x 60 minute attempts to record your best score.

Event name: Matchday Thursday – L’Arene

Event date and time: Every Thursday from 8am GMT for 24 hours

‘Matchday Thursday’ is held on L’Arene, a traditional match fishing venue. Here the rules are very simple – catch the highest weight of fish that you can with every species counting. However, tactics aren’t as simple with the lake full of smaller fish, will you try to build your weight up with the float or will you wait for some of the bigger carp to come along using carp fishing methods? You have 4 x 30 minute attempts to decide and record your best score.

Event name: Spanish Friday – Presa Del Monte Bravo

Event date and time: Every Friday from 8am GMT for 24 hours

‘Spanish Friday’ is a great way to end the competitive week by trying your hand on our mountainous venue Presa Del Monte Bravo that is home to our biggest fish including a monstrous 150lb catfish! In this tournament you are targeting mirror and leather crap as well as the big catfish so strong equipment will be needed. This is all about how many fish you can catch with the highest number winning. You have 2 x 60 minute attempts to catch your best score.




Some points to remind you of regarding our live tournaments;

1.Regardless of what settings you have chosen, the leaderboard in game will be set to metric and display your score in kilograms.

2. Please be consistent with your character / user name to ensure that you are picking up maximum points. Matt and Matthew may be the same person but will be registered as two different! Try to use something unique (but not offensive) to ensure you pick up the correct points each time.

To remind you all how the league works;
•Each week we will be hosting 6 tournaments (one per week day plus one for the weekend)

•Winning (or ranking well) in a tournament gives you League points (see appendix below)

•Players accumulate League Points over the course of each month.

•League rankings will be published and updated in this thread.

•At the end of each month the Top 10 players get a Euro-Fishing t-shirt (maximum of 4 t-shirts per player)

How to join our daily or weekend tournaments:
 1.Launch Euro Fishing

2.Once in the main menu, click on “Live Tournament” (bottom left tile)

3.Click on the proposed tournament of your choice. Win conditions will be listed in the tournament description.
 League Points (LP) awarded per tournament:

1st - 30 points
 2nd - 25 points
 3rd - 23 points
 4th - 22 points
 5th - 21 points
 6th - 20 points
 7th - 19 points
 8th - 18 points
 9th - 17 points
 10th - 16 points
 down to 25th getting 1 point.

Daily tournaments start each weekly at 08:00 BST. Weekend tournaments start each Friday at 16:00 BST.

notes.title: Update is now live!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that our latest update has been passed by Microsoft and is now available to both Xbox One and PC players. We appreciate the patience you have shown whilst this update has gone through testing and certification.

Highlights of this update include the following;

• This build aims to prevent fish from being able to swim onto the bank. We have spent over a week testing this and have not seen it happen at all. However, we cannot replicate it being played by the 10’s of thousands of you so if anyone does experience a fish going onto land, please let us know the details including which lake and which peg within that lake.

• Line ‘snapping’ randomly has also been fixed and should not happen anymore. As above, if anyone does still experience this then let us know!

• Multiple takes – now if you are playing a fish and get a fish on your second rod, you will have 2 minutes before that fish escapes. If you are lucky enough to get a bite on your third rod, you will have 4 minutes before that fish escapes.

• We have updated UE4 to version 4.12.5

• We have changed the way our physics system works so that fish now behave more realistically and make the fight feel smoother.

• Megladon – Our biggest catfish has proved very tricky to catch so we have made it slightly easier to get him to take your bait (but we aren’t telling you how!)

• Surface tension on the line so that it now floats on the water when necessary.

• Improvement to the reel mechanics.

• Fixed clients sometimes being unable to connect to multiplayer games hosted under the same NAT.

• Optimised several assets in multiple lakes

The following bugs have also been fixed in this update

• A soft lock will occur in the 'Baiting' tutorial if the user walks away from the peg.

• Score is taken in Challenges when the casting goes out of bounds and is pulled into the water.

• Steam profiles are not displayed after selection in the leaderboards.

• Rod selection and pick up rod buttons lose functionality when opening tournament map.

•  Opening and closing the pause menu causes the line to be reeled in a small amount.

• Progress in the Academy (tutorial) stages can be blocked by using a reel exploit.

• If the hook bounces on the water during a Distance challenge, it counts as two casts.

• Music plays throughout single player tournaments that is only intended to play at the beginning.

• Score is taken in Challenges when the casting goes out of bounds and is pulled into the water.

notes.title: New "Basic Cast Control" system is now live as a free update.
notes.content:
[b] 14/03/2016 [/b]

We are really excited to say that our new basic cast control system is now available as another free update.

We have seen that casting is the hottest topic in the community with people having a range of issues around our total cast control, from skill based problems through to frame rate issues. We are very proud of our total cast control system but hope that the basic cast control will deal with a lot of the issues people have been facing.

Basic cast control is a simple click of the right mouse button (or left trigger on Xbox) to enter the casting ‘state’, then you will see a power bar appear and hold down the left mouse button (or right trigger) to start filling the power bar. Simply release the button when you are happy but be careful not to go into the red zone as you will lose the accuracy of the cast! This casting method is designed to be a much simpler, hassle free system but it should really help users with low frame rates to be able to cast much more easily. In testing, we have managed to cast over 40 yards at 15 frames per second.

So, if you have experienced casting issues in the past then please give this update a go!

notes.title: Euro Fishing Feature Roadmap
notes.content:
As promised, we want to share with you our short to medium term roadmap so that you can see what we are working hard on to help improve and expand Euro Fishing;

•	Basic Cast Control 

This is being delivered imminently and will be an alternative casting system to our current Total Cast Control. As well as this, the game will be upgraded to the latest version of Unreal Engine 4 and there will be a host of bug fixes and performance improvements.

•	New rods and tackle box 

We will be adding some new Sonik rods from their 2016 range to the tackle shop. We will also be adding bread punch as a bait for float fishing and making some general improvements to the tackle shop. 

•	New netting experience

Based on your feedback and our views on the feature, we will be implementing a new netting sequence to improve the current experience. 

•	Rod Physics

We will be improving how different rods behave with some of our longer and heavier (higher test curve) rods being too bendy at present.

•	Fish Behaviour

We are constantly tweaking our fish behaviour from the moment you arrive at the lake to landing your prized catch. Improvements include escape behaviour, frequency of bites and patrolling. 

•	Xbox One 

Euro Fishing will be coming to Xbox One in May this year. The game will be identical to the PC version with all PC updates included in it.
 
•	New Urban Lake

We are in the early stages of making our 6th lake which will be an urban venue located in Central Europe.

notes.title: Challenge your skills with Float Fishing, now added free to Euro Fishing
notes.content:
The fast and furious action of float fishing is new to Dovetail Games Euro Fishing from today! This whole new way of fishing will test even the most skilled of fisherman as timing is key to land the big catch.

This exciting free update to Euro Fishing introduces a new discipline of fishing, ideal for targeting our non-carp species and smaller carp and perfect for challenging your friends in multiplayer.

To become a float fishing expert, you need to keep hold of your rod and watch the float move to indicate a bite, then it’s all about timing - strike too early or too late and the fish will escape! 

Also included are a host of new gameplay features, ideal for float fishing, including new tackle (including rods, reels and lines designed for float fishing) and new baits (including worms, maggots, bread and sweetcorn).

Plus, we've added a new boss fish to Presa Del Monte Bravo, a Ghost Carp that you have a chance to name - simply land the prize catch and post a screenshot on our Steam Community pages, and the first person to do so will get a chance to name it!

notes.title: Patch 5 - Full Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Patch 5 has just been released for Euro Fishing. Steam will automatically download and install the patch.

This patch introduces Float Fishing.

[B]Please note that the first person to catch the new Ghost Carp Boss Fish and post a screenshot in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/314520/discussions/0/494632506575906941/]THIS THREAD[/url] gets to name this boss fish.[/B]

Full patch notes are available below.

Any and all feedback welcome!

Kevin

[u]	New Content	[/U]	
[list][*]	Float Fishing:		
[list][*]	When Fishing with a float you need to perform a strike in order to hook the fish. The timing and power of the strike is essential to getting a good hook quality, to minimize the chances of the fish escaping. Too early and you risk spooking the fish and too late you risk losing your chance to hook the fish.		
[*]	New Float Waggler & Float Baits has been added to unlock in the Tackleshop		
[*]	New Float Rod and Float Reel have been added to unlock in the Tackleshop	[/list]	
[*]	Equipment:		
[list][*]	Exclusive Guru Pulse Fishing Lines have been added. 	[/list]	
[*]	Boss Fish:		
[list][*]	Ghost Carp Boss Fish has been added to Presa Del Monte Bravo.	[/list]	
[*]	Gameplay:		
[list][*]	All users will now start off with a size 20 Waggler float and a size 12 rig in their default Tacklebox. They will also have access Bloodworm and Bread Flakes baits.	[/list]	
[*]	Progression:		
[list][*]	The level cap has been increased from 20 - 25.	[/list]	
[*]	User Interface:		
[list][*]	New in-game Tool Tips have been added that specifically explain what Float Fishing is and how it works.		
[*]	Splash screen has been updated to showcase the Float update.		
[*]	Float icon has been added to the HUD		
[*]	New Ghost Carp Boss Fish has been added to the Boss Fish screen in Presa Del Monte Bravo.	[/list]	[/list]
			
[u]	Improvements	[/U]	
[list][*]	Gameplay:		
[list][*]	A new camera has been added when reeling for users to have a closer look at their bait or float and see where it is in the water.	[/list]	
[*]	Environment:		
[list][*]	The water in all our lakes has been made more opaque to replicate the look of murky waters.	[/list]	
[*]	Tackle Shop:		
[list][*]	The Tackle Shop has been updated and reorganised to include new Float gear.	[/list]	
[*]	Localisation:		
[list][*]	Russian, Polish, French, German & Czech have been updated to include new Float content.	[/list]	
[*]	Visual Effects:		
[list][*]	Added additional particle effects when using a Float.	[/list]	[/list]
			
[u]	Balancing	[/U]	
[list][*]	Gameplay:		
[list][*]	Boss Fish interest has been increased slightly to increase the frequency of getting a bite from a Boss Fish.		
[*]	Increased the time it takes for a fish to be hungry again after it has been caught.		
[*]	Hooks and Baits have been adjusted to account for Float fishing. Smaller hooks have been added to target smaller fish and larger hooks are now more likely to catch larger fish.		
[*]	The weight distribution in The Observatory has been altered slightly to make smaller fish more common than larger fish.	[/list]	[/list]
			
[u]	Bug Fixes	[/U]	
[list][*]	Gameplay:		
[list][*]	Fixed an issue where multiple fish tells we spawning from the same point.		
[*]	Fixed an issue on Digger Lakes where fish were not spawning correctly.		
[*]	Fish will no longer tire themselves out if they are hooked on a rod that is resting on the bankstick. They are now more likely to escape if users are not quick enough to swap to that rod.	[/list]	
[*]	Live Tournaments:		
[list][*]	Fixed an issue where users with a space in their character name could not play a Live Tournament.		
[*]	Potential fix for the issue where the user's score was not being updated correctly in Live Tournaments.	[/list]	
[*]	Multiplayer:		
[list][*]	Fixed a crash when leaving a Multiplayer session when you have a peg claimed.		
[*]	Fixed an issue where the UI would not work correctly for the Host in Multiplayer.		
[*]	Fixed a crash in Multiplayer that caused joining users to crash when a message was sent in the Chat window.		
[*]	Fixed a rare crash in MP if the user's character fails to spawn.		
[*]	Fixed a rare crash where some users would crash when presenting a fish in Multiplayer.		
[*]	Fixed a crash when a user leaves the session with a fish on their line.	[/list]	
[*]	Localization:		
[list][*]	Fixed an issue where certain text was not being translated correctly.		
[*]	Fixed several issues with spelling mistakes and grammatical errors in the English text.	[/list]	
[*]	User Interface:		
[list][*]	Fixed an issue where Tiger Nuts were not using the correct icon.		
[*]	The choosen Tacklebox will now be saved through multiplayer sessions		
[*]	The selected Tacklebox will no longer reset when looking at the settings menu.		
[*]	Fixed the bed type icon size scaling incorrectly in 1st Person view.	[/list]	
[*]	Miscellaneous		
[list][*]	Fixed an issue where the 'Living the Bream' achievement was unlocking incorrectly.		
[*]	Fixed an issue on one of the pegs in Digger Lakes where the rod stand was clipping with the peg model.	[/list]	[/list]

[u]	Known Issues: 	[/U]
[list][*]	After catching a fish while using the float mechanic, any other baits resting on the banksticks may start attracting fish as well.	
[*]	In some cases both clients and host's can lose different kinds of functionalities as a result of errors during loading - rejoin the match should fix most of them.	
[*]	The bed-typ icon can disappear below the water surface at specific locations across different lakes.	
[*]	There are multiple text clipping issues on other languages than English	
[*]	Reducing drag too far can block progression in Fish On Tutorial.	
[*]	The game is unplayable on certain screen resolutions.	
[*]	Fish can be seen trying to swim through terrain which may cause the player to lose it.	[/list]

notes.title: Patch 3 Now Available
notes.content:
[b] 30/11/2015 [/b]

Patch 3 has now been released for Euro Fishing

Changelist as follows:

[b] [u]New content and features: [/u] [/b]

- Added 8 new Roach Boss Fish.
- Added a new feature that allows species-specific Live Tournaments.
- Game is now available in Czech.
- Game is now available in Polish.
- Game is now available in Russian.

[b] [u]Improvements:[/u] [/b]

[b]Animation:[/b]

- Smoothed the transfer between states such as entering reeling after casting and netting. 

- Added a gentle idle motion to the static poses used for netting.

[b]Audio:[/b]

- Added an audio countdown for several game modes.

[b]Environment Art:[/b]

- Added missing normal map textures.

[b]Gameplay:[/b]

- Removed the ability to rotate the character with the mouse when performing a cast. You can still rotate using the movement keys on the keyboard.

[b]Main Menu: [/b]

- Deleted unused video assets and files to decrease total file size.
- Updated the splash screen to showcase new features and updates.

[b]User Interface[/b]

- Added a button prompt to the Tournament teleport map.

[b] [u]Balancing[/u] [/b]

[b]Equipment:[/b]

- All rigs that we previously tagged as All have been changed to Gravel type rigs.
- Hook sizes have been adjusted so each hook can potentially catch a wider range of fish. This now means a larger hook will not exclusively catch large fish.
- Baits have been adjusted so a smaller range of fish will target certain baits.

[b]Freedom Fishing: [/b]

- We've decreased how often Boss Fish will go for your bait.
- We've decreased the amount of TP awarded by fish weight.
- We've decreased how often fish will go for your bait.

[b] [u] Resolved Issues [/u] [/b]

[b]Animation:[/b]

- Fixed Sleeve collision with arm when presenting carp
- Fixed Sleeve collision with arm when presenting Tench

[b]Audio: [/b]

- Added water skimming back to the lead and spod.
- Fixed missed footstep audio when you first switch to first person.
- Reposition audio components on net to address inconsistent volume issue.
- Added sound to a missing ground texture.
- Fixed audio issues with the main menu.
- Fixed an audio issue when returning to the main menu from a session.

[b]Environment Art: [/b]

- Repositioned a tent that was floating at Peg 30 on St Johns Lake.
- Change the collision on Digger Lakes to make the bank more accessible.
- Fixed an issue where grass was floating in Saint Johns Lake.
- Fixed an issue with black layers appearing in Digger Lakes.
- Repositioned a floating rock in The Observatory.
- Fixed an issue where players using AMD GPUs would get flickering shadows.
- Fixed a collision issue that stop players interacting with peg 5 in The Observatory.
- Fixed an issue with the grass in The Observatory.

[b] Equipment: [/b]

- Fixed an issue where 15 lb lines were using the wrong breaking strain value.
- Fixed an issue where certain fish went for your bait regardless of its size or type.

[b] Localisation: [/b]

- Fixed an issue where certain text was not being translated.
- Fixed a number of errors in the French translation.

[b] Miscellaneous: [/b]

- Fixed an issue where in some cases the player's profile isn't saved correctly, resulting in a full reset.
- Fixed an issue where a boss fish could be caught several times in a row.
- Fixed a rare issue where some users would crash when starting the game.

[b] Multiplayer: [/b]

- Fixed an issue where players would encounter a crash in Multiplayer when a fish goes for the bait of a disconnecting player.
- Fixed an issue where players would encounter a crash when putting down their rod in multiplayer
- Fixed several instances where the game would crash in multiplayer due to animation issues
- Fixed an issue where only the host could catch fish by using 3 rods.
User Interface
- Updated the controller schemes to use one text element per line.
- Fixed text being cut off on tutorial select screen in German.
- Fixed text being cut off on the freedom fishing settings screen in German.
- Fixed text being cut off on the freedom fishing settings screen tackle box in all.
- Fixed an issue where the profile text is cut off.
- The Fish Species page has been updated to now say Common for Roach and Tench instead of an empty field.

[u] [b] Known Issues [/b] [/u]

- Fish can be randomly lost due to collision with the terrain.
- Fish can be seen moving above the water surface on Digger Lakes.
- Live Tournament in-game scoreboard does not always display the correct score in-game.
- The tension meter and pause menu is not available for the Host after playing the game for long sessions.
- The bed type icon doesn’t always display correctly.
- After catching a fish the character model will still be visible when playing in first person.

notes.title: The Flare Path: Like A Fish Out Of Water
notes.content: Traditionally, autumn is the time for virtual hunting in the Stone household. This year, for a change, I’ve decided to leave my high-velocity deer dispatcher in the gun cabinet and rely on eight feet of simulated carbon fibre for my indoors outdoors fun. Fishing Planet and Euro Fishing have six hours each in which to (A) hook me, (B) reel me in, and (C) exhaust my meagre supply of hackneyed angling metaphors. At the end of these brief but intense auditions one of the games will be granted indefinite leave to remain, the other will be tossed back into the seething Steam stew pond. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Beta Build 04.1 Now Out
notes.content:
The latest version of the beta v4.1 is now available! 

The latest content has not been polished and debugged to the same standard as our previous Phases, which allows us to concentrate on production and only worry about fine debugging at the very end of the process. 

[b]Please follow the instructions below to access and enjoy beta content, bearing in mind that you cannot have version 6.1 and Beta Build 04 installed on your computer at the same time. If you already switched from 6.1 to beta for Beta Build 01/02, your beta build will update automatically

Please also make sure you have a look at the Known Issues below. This is a beta build and nothing is set in stone at this point.[/b]

Don’t forget to give us feedback in the Penny for your Thoughts thread!

[u]Beta Build 04.1 – Change Log[/u]

• Fixed flying /floating fish
• Iterated netting to be more automated - still work in progress and has issues
• Added new character selection movies
• Updated UI imagery
• Multiplayer Crash fixes
• Other misc. bug fixes

[u]Beta Build 04.1 – Known Issues[/u]

• Netting is still a work in progress
• TP awards and progression are being tweaked.
• We believe there are still Multiplayer crashes to be found. Please report these via the Steam forums as you find them.
• Sometimes the character select becomes non-responsive with a black screen. Users can try pressing the spacebar to continue or if that doesn’t work, try re-starting.

[u]To install the beta version and content:[/u]

1.Open Steam
2.Open the Library tab
3.Right click on Dovetail Games Fishing
4.Select Properties from the menu
5.Select the Beta tab at the top
6.In the password field, type YG9fdfYwKPFQTh3g
7.Click the Check Code button
8.From the drop down menu, select beta - Closed Beta Branch
9.Dovetail Games Fishing will now update to the Beta version
10.In the Steam Library, your game will be listed as Dovetail Games Fishing [beta]

[u]To uninstall the beta version and content:[/u]

1.Open Steam
2.Open the Library tab
3.Right click on Dovetail Games Fishing [beta]
4.Select Properties from the menu
5.Select the Beta tab at the top
6.From the drop down menu, select NONE - Opt out of all beta programs
7.Dovetail Games Fishing will now update back to version 0.6.1
8.In the Steam Library, your game will be listed as Dovetail Games Fishing

Kevin

[*][U]Maps[/U]:
[list][*]General for All Lakes - All lakes are still a work in progress and should NOT be considered 'finished'. 
[*]We're playing with various graphics settings at the moment and so lakes look at different quality levels. This will be improved over time as we add more detail to the levels.
[*]Digger Lake - Ongoing work with framerate and also final placement of assets. Updated bed types have been implemented.
[*]L'Arène Lake - This is now fully playable with placeholder gameplay. Lighting work is placeholder which makes the world look flat. Artists are actively working on this. Progress will be shared in the next beta update.

notes.title: Start of beta pushed back just a few days
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Last week we [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/dtgfishing/announcements/detail/800867765742179262]announced[/url] that the beta for Dovetail Games Fishing would start on Tuesday, September the 8th. After careful examination of some bugs that appeared in our very latest build, we are pushing back the start of beta a few days; the beta should start within the next week.

We are fully aware that the new beta content is eagerly awaited by our community, but we did not want to push out a broken patch which would have been frustrating and disappointing because of a few very annoying bugs. The content we have for you in Beta Build 01 includes the new lakes, procedural weather and procedural time of day, and we are looking forward to collecting your feedback on all of them.

Thank you for your patience and understanding, we will update you as soon as possible.

Regards,

The Dovetail Games Team

Hello everyone,

Last week we [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/dtgfishing/announcements/detail/800867765742179262]announced[/url] that the beta for Dovetail Games Fishing would start on Tuesday, September the 8th. After careful examination of some bugs that appeared in our very latest build, we are pushing back the start of beta a few days; the beta should start within the next week.

We are fully aware that the new beta content is eagerly awaited by our community, but we did not want to push out a broken patch which would have been frustrating and disappointing because of a few very annoying bugs. The content we have for you in Beta Build 01 includes the new lakes, procedural weather and procedural time of day, and we are looking forward to collecting your feedback on all of them.

Thank you for your patience and understanding, we will update you as soon as possible.

Regards,

The Dovetail Games Team

notes.title: Dovetail Games Fishing to enter beta on September 8th.
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Our development team first started working on Dovetail Games Fishing in early 2014 with the aim of creating a fun fishing simulator using cutting edge technology. The game entered Early Access on November the 4th 2014 and since then we have been tirelessly working with the community to add and refine mechanics and content.

We are infinitely grateful to the community for supporting us every step of the way and helping create the best fishing game in the world. We have done much together already, but as the release date approaches we want to make the release, testing and refining of features and content even faster.

In order to achieve this, we will introduce a new accelerated beta process that will temporarily make the game unavailable to purchase on Steam but allow us to add more content, faster. Players who already own the game will be able to continue enjoying phase 6.1 or test the latest content. The latest content will not be polished and debugged to the same standard as our previous Phases, which will allow us to concentrate on production and only worry about fine debugging at the very end of the process (the game will then be thoroughly polished and debugged right before launch). 

More details will be made available when beta starts on Tuesday, September the 8th.

Dovetail Games

[U]In summary:[/U]
[list][*][B]On Tuesday, September the 8th Dovetail Games Fishing will exit Early Access and move into a “closed pre-order phase” until the full launch of the game in late October.[/B]
[*]Players who already own the game will have access to both existing and new content during this phase.
[*]New players will still be able to pre-order the game but not to play it until release 
[*]Patches will be more frequent, with players always having access to the latest content, but there will be more bugs. This is done to speed up the development/feedback loop.
[*]Anyone who purchased the game during Early Access or pre-ordered it after Tuesday, September the 8th will get the full game on release, same as everyone who purchases the game post-release. 
[*]The first batch of new content will be available when the beta starts.
[*]Full details about the technical aspects of joining the beta will be posted on Tuesday, September the 8th.

notes.title: Opening of an Official DTG Fishing Mumble Server
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

A key part of fishing is going to the lake with friends and talking to each other, be it about different tactics for the session ahead or just having a good catch up whilst you wait for that bite.

One of the challenges of using the latest technology to bring fishing games to a whole new level is that the tools we use (namely the UE4 game engine) are still being developed. This means that while they bring exciting new opportunities in terms of game quality, they might sometimes not yet support some functionalities that are common in older technology.

Dovetail Games Fishing will naturally have native voice chat by the time it launches, but it will take a little while.

In the meantime, we have opened a 200-slot Mumble server for you. 


[U][B]WHAT IS MUMBLE?[/B][/U]

[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mumble_(software)]Mumble[/url] is a voice over IP (VoIP) programme primarily designed for use by gamers. It’s audio chat.

The server we have created is entirely free to use for all our community members.

Our server offers chat rooms for the following languages:
[list][*]English
[*]French
[*]German
[*]Italian
[*]Japanese
[*]Polish
[*]Portuguese
[*]Russian
[*]Spanish
[*]Japanese[/list]

It also has 10 [I]other languages[/I] rooms for people speaking any language not listed above.

[B]Please note that while the usual [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/314520/discussions/0/620695877480234767/]DTG Fishing Hub Rules[/url] apply to Mumble, we will not be monitoring the chat rooms and cannot guarantee a PEGI 3 environment so user discretion is advised.

Please also bear in mind that you should not share your account password with ANYONE and that Dovetail Games employees will never request this information.[/B]
 

[U][B]HOW DOES MUMBLE WORK?[/B][/U]

[U]Step 1 – Getting & Installing Mumble.[/U]

Visit the [url=http://www.mumble.info]Mumble website[/url] and download the latest Stable Release ([url=https://github.com/mumble-voip/mumble/releases/download/1.2.9/mumble-1.2.9.msi]direct download link if you’re using Windows[/url]. 

When the software has downloaded, run the executable and select client during the installation. Once it is installed it might be useful to place a shortcut on the desktop (if not done automatically) or even on the ‘Quick Launch' bar. This is entirely up to you.


[U] Step 2 – Setting Up and Connecting to a Server. [/U]

When you first start the Mumble client, you will get asked to run a brief audio setup wizard.

This is the main Mumble window, which lists quite a few servers on one page, and lets you setup custom servers on the left hand side. 

To access the Dovetail Games Fishing you will have to:
[olist][*]Click on [I]Server > Connect[/I] in the upper-left-hand corner menu.
[*]In the window that pops up, click [I]Add New…[/I].
[*]In the Add Server window that pops up please input the following information:
Label: Dovetail Games Fishing
Address: [B]85.236.100.139[/B]
Port: [B]2037[/B]
Username: your username
[*]The server will then ask you for a password. The password is [B]dtgfishing[/B].
[*]Accept the server’s certificate.
[*]Once you’ve joined the server, right-click on your name and Register your user name to make sure nobody else uses it.[/olist]


That’s it! The Dovetail Games Fishing server will now appear in your list of servers. All you have to do is pick a room with whomever you’re playing with and you’re good to go!

Let us know [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/314520/discussions/6/530646080865920195/]HERE[/url] if you have any questions. We've opened a new [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/314520/discussions/6/]Multiplayer[/url] forum so be sure to drop by on your way to the virtual lake!

Enjoy,

Kevin

notes.title: Dovetail Games Fishing Early Access Phase Six Out Now
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

Phase 6 content is now available in game.

Full patch notes are available below and you can watch either our [url=www.youtube.com/watch?v=8-hlXdY30r0]Phase 6 Summary Video[/url] or our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KCTlP4jkoXc]70-minute-long Twitch preview, complete with Q&A Session[/url] to know everything you need to know about Phase 6.

You'll find the central feedback thread [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/314520/discussions/0/530645446315042318/]HERE[/url] 

Enjoy, 

The DTG Team

[U][B]EARLY ACCESS PHASE 6 – FULL PATCH NOTES (388.9MB PATCH)[/B][/U]


[B][U]New Game Mode - Freedom Fishing Synchronized Multiplayer.[/U][/B]

Phase 6 features the alpha version of our synchronised 5-player multiplayer fishing experience. [B]The mode has been released to the public purely to assist with highlighting any connection and backend server problems and it does not represent a final gameplay experience.[/B]

Use the multiplayer lobby screens to host or join a match or invite your friends to a private session. Players should be able to fish just like in single player, but if any gameplay issues or bugs arise please log [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/314520/discussions/4/530645446315045140/]those with us via our Steam forum.[/url]


[B][U]New Gameplay - Netting A Fish.[/U][/B]

Players are now required to use a landing net to catch fish: they will not automatically become caught when they’re close to the bank.

When a battle with a fish is coming to an end the fish will exhibit submissive behaviour. If the fish is close enough to the player to be netted, players can pick up their landing net by pressing ‘E’ on the keyboard or X on their gamepad and then use either the WASD keys or left stick to control the landing net. Players will need to be careful when landing as additional tension can be applied to the fish which may result in the fish escaping. Once the fish is in the net it will automatically become caught.


[B][U]New Content - Female Character.[/U][/B]

Our second playable character is now available in game. The female angler can be chosen in our new character select screen after booting the game. Use the arrow keys to toggle between male and female and then click the highlighted option to name your character.

notes.title: Carp & Bream Weekend Competition #2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Are you ready for another weekend of competitive fishing? Many of you reached out to us after last weekend's event to tell us you had fun, so the [B]Carp & Bream Weekend Competition[/B] is back by popular demand.

Please note that we've introduced the following rule (#3): [i]A single fish cannot count more than once, even if you catch it several times.[/I]

[U]Competition Summary:[/U] catch the five biggest carps and the biggest bream you can this weekend, and post your screenshots in this thread. The 3 players with the highest cumulated weight win something. Bonus points for leather carps.

[U]Rules[/U]
[olist][*]Competition runs from Saturday, May 30th at 00:01 until Sunday, May 31st at 23:59 (based on your timezone).
[*]Only fish caught during these two days will count towards your total.
[*]A single fish cannot count more than once, even if you catch it several times. 
[*]You can fish for  as long as you want and catch as many fish as you want, but you can only pick six fish in total to count towards your total (5 carps and 1 bream)
[*]Entrants should post screenshots of the 5 largest carps and the largest bream [U]altogether in one post[/U] in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/314520/discussions/0/618463106379321972/]THIS THREAD[/url]. No screenshot, no points.
[*]Each entrant’s submissions will be tallied by DTG Staff on Monday, June 1st.
[*]Leather carp will count as weighing an extra 5lbs compared to common or mirror carp. 
[*]The top player will receive a DTG Fishing t-shirt and have a peg named after them for the duration of Phase 6.
[*]The following two players will have a peg named after them for the duration of Phase 6.
[/olist]

[U]How to take screenshots and add them to your post[/U]
[olist][*]You can take a screenshot by pressing F12. Please note that your screenshots will only be uploaded to your Steam profile after you close your game.
[*]To access your screenshots, go to Steam and find your screenshots under [I]Content[/I] in the Tab named after you (top centre).
[*]Right-click on the screenshot you want to add to your post and click on ‘copy link address’
[*]The screenshot will be automatically embedded into your post[/olist]

Do let us know if you have any questions and good luck to all!

The DTG Team

notes.title: New Dovetail Games player support system launching

[/list]

[B]EARLY ACCESS PHASE 5 – FULL PATCH NOTES[/B]

[U]New Fish - Bream.[/U]
Bream now feature in the game. These are relatively common in the lake and are in the 2lb to 5lb weight range.


[U]Switching Rods.[/U]
In Phase 5, players will have 3 rods to use in Freedom Fishing mode. Players can call up the UI rod selection widget by pressing [I]Tab[/I] on the keyboard or pressing [I]Left[/I] or [I]Right[/I] on a gamepad. Use your mouse or left stick on gamepad to control the cursor and highlight each available rod. 

Use the mouse to move the cursor and hover over each rod in the UI element. Pressing [I]A[/I] on the controller or enter on the keyboard (or left clicking the mouse) will select the rod that is currently highlighted in the widget and equip it.

Players can also quick switch rods by pressing [I]1[/I], [I]2[/I] or [I]3[/I] on their keyboard to switch to rod 1, 2 or 3.

notes.title: Dovetail Games Fishing Early Access Phase Four Out Now
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Phase 4 is now live!

A full [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IaQrg60N46U&list=TLUvDMbysdKws]dev interview and Phase 4 preview is available on YouTube[/url], and full details are available both below and on our [url=https://dtgfishing.com/phase-4-is-released-today/]website[/url].

Steam will automatically start 467MB download and install this update. 

You'll find the central feedback thread [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/314520/discussions/0/618457398960543797/]HERE[/url]

Enjoy,

The DTG Team

PS: do take screenshots if you catch a leather carp. They're very rare!


[U]Updated Physics Engine[/U]

Phase 4 introduces our new physics engine. This means that every aspect of our casting, reeling, fish behaviour and line behaviour has had to be tweaked and rebalanced. The change was required to give us the granularity in behaviour that we needed for our line and reeling. Reeling is now force based so, just as in real life, it will be impossible to reel against a fish that is pulling very strongly against you. Hopefully, you’ll also notice that our line behaves more realistically when in casting mode. There’s still some work to do with the tension of the line in certain situations but that will be completed in a later phase.

[U]Peg Interaction[/u]

In Phase 4 players can now interact in multiple way with pegs in Freedom Fishing.

[B]Leaving a Peg[/B]: Players still have the option to the leave their peg and walk around the lake, however in Phase 4 there are additional features implemented for this step.

[B]Warning Message[/B]: Players will now put their rod down on the bank stick and enter walking mode if they choose to leave the peg. The player will be allowed to walk a short distance from their peg before they are presented with a warning message, to inform them that they are leaving their peg and it will be automatically closed if they continue to walk away from their peg. 

[B]Closing the Peg[/B]: Players will have the option to close their peg. This is done by being in walking mode near the peg and holding down R on the keyboard or B button on the Xbox controller. A button prompt should appear on the bottom right of the screen to show to the player when they can close the peg. Closing the peg removes all their gear from the peg and means you can now freely walk around the lake. To open a new peg simply press F to fish.

[U]Picking Up & Putting Down the Rod[/U]

In Phase 4, Players now have the option to Pick Up and Put Down their Rod.

[B]Put Down Rod:[/B] To put down the rod simply press the [i]Space Bar[/i] after casting.

[B]Pick-Up Prompt:[/B] Players can pick up a rod by walking up to their already claimed peg and pressing the F button on the Keyboard or A on Xbox Controller.

[U]Bite Alarms[/U]

The player now has the opportunity to use bite alarms to alert the player when a fish is on the line. To use a bite alarm, players need to perform a cast and then press [i]Space Bar[/i] on their keyboard or ‘B’ on their controller to put their rod down and set the bite alarm. The bail arm must currently be closed to make the bite alarm work.

When a fish is on the line, the bite alarm will emit a noise and flash depending on how quickly the line is being taken by a fish. Players can pick up the rod by pressing ‘F’ on their keyboard or ‘A’ on their controller when they are standing near the rod.

Note: Currently you need the drag to be set very low for the bite alarm to work. We will be fixing this in future releases.

[U]Lake Depth & Bed Types[/U]

An icon on the left-hand side of the screen now tells the player how deep their bait is.

An icon on the left-hand side of the screen now tells the player what the lake bed consists of where they are. There are four bed types: silt, gravel, weed and undefined.

[u]Drag Wheel[/u]
 
Phase 4 introduces the new Drag Wheel widget in the bottom-right-hand corner of the screen. The new drag widget will show the line tension as a progress bar. It will have indicators for when the tension is too high and too low, an audio cue will play when the high or low indicator is reached.

The line clip information is now moved to the drag wheel and is shown as a text prompt. 

Another change to the drag wheel is the Drag Adjustment, it should now be set as a percentage where 0 is no drag tension and 100 is maximum drag tension. 

[U]Rig Selection[/U]

The player now has the opportunity to use different rigs which are specialised for certain scenarios. Players can change the type of rig they are using by opening the Inventory menu in Freedom Fishing. To open the Inventory players can press ‘I’ on their keyboard or ‘Back’ on their controller.

The Inventory contains key information about the rod the player currently has equipped. In Phase 4 players can change what rig option they have equipped by moving their cursor over the rig option and selecting it by pressing the ‘Left Mouse Button’ or by pressing ‘A’ on their controller. 
 
The equipped rig option will be shown at the top of the inventory and will also be highlighted in the Rig section of the user interface. To close the Inventory menu, simply press ‘I’ on the keyboard or ‘Back’ on the controller.

[B]When to Use Different Rigs[/B]: The rigs in Phase 4 are designed to be used over specific bed types. Here’s a brief explanation for when you should use different rigs:
[list][*]DF Rig or KD Rig for silt. 
[*]IQ-D Rig for gravel.
[*]Chod Rig for weed.[/list]

[U]Fish Movement[/U]

Players will now be able to see the fish moving on the line in Phase 4. This will be the very first implementation of it and will not be representative of the final implementation. In this version the fish will just use a simple move animation. It will not turn, rotate or have any complex movement in this phase.


[U]Fish Types[/U]

In Phase 4, we are making a couple of changes to the fish spawned in the lake.

[B]Mirror Carp[/B]
We have introduced a new system for our mirror carp which means they should have different scale patterns as well as different colour differences.

[B]Leather Carp[/B]
We have introduced a new type of fish into the game, the Leather Carp. This will be a very rare type of fish. They are exceptionally elusive so please send us your images of them should you catch one!


[U]Misc. Improvements[/U]

[B]Leader boards[/B]: pressing the UP arrow on the leader board takes you to the top 5 places. Pressing the DOWN arrow takes you back to your score. There is no user interface in place for this yet but it does work.

[B]User Interface[/B]: switched our entire user interface system to the new UE4 UMG system. 

[B]Freedom Fishing[/B] added a teleport user interface element to the start of freedom fishing

[B]Xbox 360 Controllers[/B]:
[list][*]Increased the speed of the control stick to make it easier for players to cast
[*]Reset has been moved to RB
[*]Full Xbox 360 controller support
[*]Force feedback has been added to ‘reeling’ and ‘finger on line’[/list]

[B]Tutorial USER INTERFACE[/B]
[list][*]Presentation for the tutorial has been redesigned with new user interface and audio elements
[*]All tutorials have been revised for accommodate new user interface and audio elements[/list]

[B]Bug Fixes[/B]
[list][*]Fixed a bug where the fish float above the water
[*]Fixed a bug where the player cannot use the mouse to navigate the main menu
[*]Fix a bug where the distance text widget isn’t set to hidden correctly
[*]Fix a bug where the character is receiving decals from the environment
[*]Tweak down the frequency of catching a maximum weight fish. Too many people are catching the 25lbs fish and very high 24lbs fish. 
[*]The rod appears in frame after trying to move on from the catch screen in Freedom Fishing[/list]

notes.title: Dovetail Games Fishing Early Access Phase Two Out Now
notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/314520

Dovetail Games Fishing Early Access Phase Two is now available on Steam. Featuring new Global and local fish AI, Environmental Carp ‘shows’, Lake exploration and peg selection, First person casting, Ambient audio control system and Complete controller functionality. 

[b]Global Fish AI[/b]

We’ve introduced the concept of a Global Fish AI solution to the lake. This is the underlying behaviour system for our general population of fish in the lake and determines how the carp move around their habitat. The system takes into account the most basic needs for carp.

1.Food - this is currently only based on natural food that can be found in the lake and is set by our game designers.

2.Oxygen - Obviously fish need oxygen to breathe and through our research and practical knowledge we understand how oxygen levels in a lake change over time. We have a model for this which is an underlying variable for how carp migrate around the lake. 

Following on we will also add water temperature. With temperature such a critical variable in carp behaviour we have the ability to automatically affect the water temperature based on a number of factors such as time of day, season and lake depth.

All these variables are currently set to our baseline level and we’d appreciate your feedback on how you feel the fish behave in the game. For example, do they show enough? Do they seem to move around the lake realistically based on their shows?

[b]Local Fish AI[/b]

To supplement the Global Fish AI we also have a new Local Fish AI feature. Whenever the player does something within the sphere of influence of the Global Fish AI such as casting their line out we then use Local Fish AI to create individual fish personalities (individually simulated carp). Not only will these carp be of different sizes and colours they will also react differently after they’ve taken your bait depending on their size and will have differing amounts of stamina. 

Again, this is only our baseline behaviour and we welcome your continued feedback on look, feel and behaviour to help us refine this feature.

[b]Fish ‘shows’[/b]

Now we have our baseline Global Fish AI populating our lake it means that we now know where our fish actually are and can attribute different ‘shows’ to them. Currently we have two shows; bubbles breaking on the surface of the water causing ripples and water splashes where carp ‘breach’ the surface. In later phases we will add to these shows (lake bed being disturbed with plumes of mud rising, actual fish breaching, etc).

[b]Lake Exploration and fishing from different pegs[/b]

The player now has the opportunity to explore the lake environment and hunt for signs of carp as they move around their environment. If you choose to cast your line in an area where there are no fish present then just as in real life, you aren’t going to catch anything. Use the lake exploration feature to increase your chance of catching.

Players now have the ability to fish from various pegs in our training lake. Though the lake isn’t 100% complete it is now in a playable state. You’ll notice that bushes deform to the characters movement for example. The team will begin to add more individual features to pegs / swims in the coming weeks.

[b]Updated Fish[/b]

We now feature fish of different sizes and colours in our game. It’s currently using the same Common Carp model, scaled to an approximate weight and size. In future releases we’ll be working to create unique looking fish so players can specimen hunt just like real life. Feel free to send us an image of your biggest catches!

[b]Complete Controller Functionality[/b]

If you have a gamepad connected to your PC then this should now be fully supported. Please report all issues with this to us in the usual way. We’ve tested this on a Microsoft X360 wired controller.

[b]First Person Casting[/b]

We’ve had a lot of interest from the community for a first person mode in the game. We’ve added a first person camera to the lake exploration feature and because we think it’s a cool feature we re-prioritised this for casting too. If you press F1 when in casting mode then you’ll go into a first person mode. Press F2 to return to third person. This is a very quick implementation of this feature - it’s included purely to get your feedback so please fire away!

[b]Ambient Audio Control System[/b]

A dynamic audio system has been put in place to control ambient audio around the entirety of the training lake. This currently includes wildlife, foliage, aircrafts and birds (which spawn randomly with basic song cycles). This system will be continually updated as the game develops. 

Now available on Steam
